# FR-2: Rotating Space Station with Docking Port

## Status
draft

## Description

The system shall provide a rotating space station with a clearly defined docking port that the spacecraft must approach.

## Rationale

The rotating station is the target for the docking maneuver. The rotation adds complexity and realism to the simulation, requiring the user to account for the station's movement during approach.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Space station rotates at a constant rate
- Docking port is clearly visible and distinguishable from the station hull
- Docking port location is fixed relative to the station structure
- Station rotation is visually apparent to the user
- Docking port maintains its position relative to the rotating station
- Station rotation does not affect docking port functionality

## Notes

The rotation mechanics should be predictable so users can learn to anticipate the port's position during approach.
